storage.title: File storage
storage.subtitle: Manage private object storage and the policy for new uploads; existing files keep reading from their original platform
storage.introTitle: Saved, applied and read/write-checked are shown separately
storage.introDescription: File storage is registered dynamically by this workbench and the service. Environment connections and the encryption root stay in the deployment configuration; secrets are never written to browser storage or shown again.
storage.pendingTitle: A storage operation is not confirmed yet
storage.pendingDescription: New changes are paused; the original request ID is used to read back the final state.
storage.formInvalid: The form did not pass validation. Check the provider, the full service address, bucket, region and paired credentials; nothing was sent.
storage.settingsInvalid: The policy did not pass validation. Check the default platform, seconds and file size limit; nothing was sent.

errors.recoveryUnreadable: The operation recovery ID cannot be read safely. Restore this browser's session storage and come back; do not resubmit the unknown operation.
errors.recoveryUncleared: The operation finished, but its recovery ID could not be cleared. Restore session storage and come back; new submissions are blocked.
errors.loadFailed: The storage configuration and policy could not be read. Read them again; the current state is not confirmed.
errors.outcomeUnknown: The outcome is unknown. Keep reading it back; nothing was resubmitted.
errors.lookupFailed: The original operation cannot be confirmed right now (it may not be found yet). Keep the request ID and keep reading back; do not resubmit.
errors.recoveryUnsaved: A safe recovery ID could not be saved, so nothing was sent. Restore session storage and try again.
errors.requestIdConflict: The request ID conflicts. Keep it and read back only; do not resubmit.
errors.forbidden: Your identity has no storage management permission. Check your sign-in and permissions.
errors.submitUnconfirmed: The submission is not confirmed yet; reading it back.

failures.STORAGE_VERSION_CONFLICT: Another operation updated this configuration. Read it again and check.
failures.STORAGE_SETTINGS_VERSION_CONFLICT: The default configuration or policy changed. Read it again and check.
failures.STORAGE_CONFIG_REFERENCED: The configuration is referenced by files and cannot be deleted.
failures.STORAGE_DEFAULT_CONFIG: The current default configuration cannot be deleted; switch the default first.
failures.STORAGE_LOCATION_IMMUTABLE: The object location cannot be changed in place; create a new configuration.
failures.STORAGE_REQUEST_ID_REUSED: The request ID conflicts. Keep the original operation record and contact an administrator.
failures.STORAGE_CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED: Enter the new access ID and secret as a pair.
failures.STORAGE_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The service has not enabled this storage provider.
failures.STORAGE_ENDPOINT_NOT_ALLOWED: This storage address is outside what the service allows.
failures.STORAGE_PRIVATE_ACCESS_ALLOWED: The anonymous read check failed; check the bucket's private access settings.
failures.STORAGE_CLEANUP_FAILED: The probe object could not be cleaned up; an administrator needs to handle it.
failures.STORAGE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The outcome is unknown; keep reading it back.
failures.default: The operation did not finish. Read the state again or contact the platform administrator.

list.title: Saved storage configurations
list.empty: No storage configuration matches. Add one and make it the default explicitly before new uploads can use it.

probe.STALE: Only an older revision was probed

intent.probeWarning: This writes, reads and cleans up a synthetic probe object and may incur storage request charges.
intent.deleteWarning: Only the management metadata of an unreferenced, non-default configuration is deleted; the bucket and existing files stay.
intent.uploadWarning: This affects later uploads; existing files keep reading from their original platform and nothing is moved.

editor.introDescription: Credentials are sent one way and old secrets are never read. Saving does not verify the read/write connection; after new uploads stop, existing files still read from their original platform.
editor.referencesValue: {{count}}; the object location is fixed, create a new configuration to migrate
editor.name: Display name
editor.nameRule: Enter a name of at most 120 characters
editor.providerRule: Choose a provider the service has enabled
editor.endpointHint: A full http(s) origin without path, account, query or signature. Cloud providers use HTTPS; private addresses must be allowed by the backend.
editor.regionHintCos: Tencent COS builds the service address from the bucket and region.
editor.regionHint: Fill in as the provider requires; leave empty when not required.
editor.uploadHint: Stopping only blocks new writes; existing files stay readable.
editor.keep: Keep the existing credentials; send no secret fields
editor.replace: Replace the credentials; enter both new values
editor.credentialsHidden: Only whether credentials are configured is shown; old secrets are never shown, read or filled in.
editor.confirmDescription: This configuration is used for file storage by every tenant. Saving only confirms the configuration operation; reads, writes and private access still need a separate probe.
editor.confirmCredentials: A new pair of credentials will be sent; the secret is never shown.

operation.title: Storage operation
operation.description: The final state of a configuration operation or read/write probe, by request ID.
operation.pendingTitle: The original operation has no confirmed final state
operation.pendingDescription: The same request ID is used to read it back; create, update, delete or probe is never resent. Reloading the page reads it back first too.
operation.cleanupTitle: The probe cleanup needs more checking
operation.cleanupDescription: Finished write or read steps do not mean the cleanup succeeded. Keep this request ID and contact the platform administrator.
operation.configNote: A finished configuration operation does not mean the provider connection works. Start a read/write probe from the list when needed.

settings.legacy: Mapping for files without a platform
settings.defaultHint: After switching, new uploads from every tenant use the chosen platform; existing files keep reading from their original platform. Only applied platforms that allow new uploads can be chosen.
settings.defaultPlaceholder: Add and enable a storage configuration first
settings.maxUploadHint: Current input: {{current}}; server limit: {{max}}. The server still checks the actual content and permissions.
settings.range: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}
settings.privateNote: Private access is always on; there is no anonymous public switch.
settings.confirmWarningTitle: Affects later uploads and signatures for every tenant
settings.confirmWarning: Objects are not moved; existing files keep reading from their original platform. The change is checked against the policy version and must be read again on conflict.
